CustomField.description: FCRM-848 This field is created to display the wait icon along with the number of days a case has been in a Queue.
CustomField.formula:
IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Web'), CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight'), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Resolved'))), IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhh&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", Text(Status), 30, 30)+' '+Text(Status), IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Web'), CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight'), If(Hour(TIMENOW())>Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)), (Hour(TIMENOW())- Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)) +(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24) <= 24, (Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - Hour(TIMENOW())+(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24) <= 24 ) ), IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhi&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", Text(Case_Open_Time_Hours__c), 20, 20)+' ' +
If(Hour(TIMENOW())>Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)), Text(Hour(TIMENOW())- Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))+(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24), Text(Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))- Hour(TIMENOW())+(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24))+' Hours',
IF(AND( ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Web'), CONTAINS(RecordType.Name, 'Qantas Freight'), If(Hour(TIMENOW())>Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)), (Hour(TIMENOW())- Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)) +(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24) > 24, (Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)) - Hour(TIMENOW())+(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24) > 24 )
), IMAGE("https://qantas.lightning.force.com/servlet/servlet.ImageServer?id=0152v00000IRHhj&oid=00D8s00000IDoz7&lastMod=1647355817000", Text(Case_Open_Time_Hours__c), 20, 20)+' ' +
If(Hour(TIMENOW())>Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate)), Text(Hour(TIMENOW())- Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))+(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24), Text(Hour(TIMEVALUE(CreatedDate))- Hour(TIMENOW())+(Today()-DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24))+' Hours', Text(Status)) ) )
CustomField.label: Case Unresolved Period
